# Legacy single-file theorem citations

::: {.theorem #thm:legacy-torelli title="Legacy Torelli"}
Two marked Enriques surfaces with the same period point are isomorphic.
:::

The uniqueness statement is exactly @thm:legacy-torelli applied to the
covering K3 surface, and the prefixed form [see @thm:legacy-torelli]
keeps its authored text on this path too.
